warnings: Mark-to-orientation pattern on this sheet (verified consistent across every readable segment): B1 = horizontal (x-direction) beams at any level; B2 = vertical (y-direction) beams on the two PERIMETER column lines (grid 1 and grid 4); B3 = vertical (y-direction) beams on the two INTERIOR column lines (grid 2 and grid 3, framing the stairwell void S1). Levels in parentheses on the plan are each beam's own printed top level in metres relative to the house datum (ระดับดินเดิม, ±0.000) — recorded here as level_m on each element.

Row B (between grid 1-2 and grid 3-4) prints NO beam line at all — just the plain grid line with C1 markers at both ends and empty space between, in contrast to the clearly double-lined B1(+0.40) beam drawn for the grid 2-3 segment at the same row. Confirmed on a 2x zoom crop; not an omission on our part — the slab in those two bays evidently spans directly onto the row-A/row-C and grid-1/grid-4 beams without a mid-span row-B beam.

West/north appendage (carport + kitchen slab, S0 markers, level +0.10~+0.45) sits in the grid1-grid2 x row A-A' zone, outside the main house footprint per architecture (หน้า03). Its interior split beam B1(+0.35) lands on dummy row A' (pos_m=1.60, see grid master). The appendage's perimeter (grid1 vertical A-B) is confirmed as B2(+0.35); no further beam label could be read for grid1 south of row B in this appendage zone despite 2x-2.2x zooming, so nothing is recorded south of B1 on grid1 — left blank rather than guessed.

A small unlabelled marker 'B0 (+0.10)' sits just west of grid1 at row C (a small square with an X, drawn like a floor opening/drain symbol rather than a column or footing box) — no legend on this sheet or elsewhere in the set defines it. Recorded as a low-confidence slab/opening marker, not as a footing or column (the footing plan หน้า14 shows no footing at this position).

South recessed room (a small slab box south of row C, between grid 1-2, bounded by B1(+0.30) beams and two 'RB1'' corner pieces) has NO matching footing on หน้า14 at its south corners, and no printed dimension anywhere in this set gives its exact south projection distance from row C despite repeated 2x-2.2x zoom attempts — the small crosshair tick marks in that area (0.40/0.60, see grid master unassigned_dimensions) do not resolve cleanly to this box's corners. Its south edge is recorded with an approximate '~' grid_ref per the same convention §10a uses for stairs, and confidence_score is lowered accordingly. Genuine ambiguity, not a guess dressed up as a reading.

'RB1'' (a distinct printed beam mark, not a dummy-grid-prime notation — confirmed by its own rebar section on หน้า20) appears 3 times on this sheet: once near the stairwell void's NW corner (~A2, level +0.40) and twice at the south recess's bottom corners (level +0.30 each). Kept as 3 separate atomic entries (span/beam element, never merged) per §4.

Slab-direction arrows with a level figure (e.g. '+0.45', '+0.50') appear throughout the interior bays — these mark precast-plank laying direction/slab top level within each bay, not distinct elements, and were not individually extracted (same treatment as the precedent house 28บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_12 used for its slab-direction arrows).
